title: MWS 8-year resurvey — Reproductive/Hormonal
description: Menopausal hormone treatment (HRT) status, type, and duration recorded at the 8-year resurvey. No 'age started HRT' field exists in this wave -- the block is smaller than the other two tables' HRT blocks.

F2HTNPC.title: HRT use: never/past/current/status not known
F2HTNPC.$comment: Steward confirmed the same skip family already confirmed twice (recruitment's D039, resurvey_3yr's D052) applies here. F2HTNPC=4 ('Ever, status not known') deliberately left unconstrained by the skip pair below, same treatment as the other two tables -- D090.

F2HTTYPE.title: Type of HRT
F2HTTYPE.x-universe: Participants who have ever used HRT (F2HTNPC=2 Past or 3 Current).
F2HTTYPE.$comment: Same code list as recruitment's RHTTYPE and resurvey_3yr's F1HTTYPE. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on F2HTNPC -- D090.

F2HTLU.title: Time since HRT last used
F2HTLU.x-universe: Participants who used HRT in the past but have stopped (F2HTNPC=2 Past only) -- a current user has no 'last used' age.
F2HTLU.$comment: Valid range 0-40 is source-stated (matches resurvey_3yr's F1HTLU, which also had this exact source-stated range). not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on F2HTNPC -- D090.

F2HTDUR.title: Total duration of HRT use
F2HTDUR.x-universe: Participants who have ever used HRT (F2HTNPC=2 Past or 3 Current).
F2HTDUR.$comment: Source states no valid range; 0-50 reuses recruitment's RHTDUR and resurvey_3yr's F1HTDUR bound (D051), for consistency across all three tables. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on F2HTNPC -- D090.
